Experience the Arctic from the water with a unique and exotic stay in the heart of Tromsø, overlooking the iconic Tromsdalstinden mountain. The Yacht Grosso is a rare hidden gem, discreetly moored in a quiet marina just minutes from the old town and Vervet. Enjoy privacy, comfort, and a true seaside atmosphere while staying close to everything the city has to offer, year-round, in a calm and protected harbour setting. Perfect for couples, families, or friends seeking unforgettable Arctic escape

The space
You enter the yacht through a spacious wheelhouse with ample room to hang outerwear and leave your outdoor shoes. While on board, you can change into the comfortable wool slippers provided.

The heart of the yacht is a generous lounge featuring a cozy seating area and a dedicated dining space, located next to the large open-plan kitchen. The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you need to prepare meals and enjoy a self-catered stay. A large side-by-side refrigerator and freezer with an ice dispenser offers plenty of space for all food and beverages.

Guest access
The spacious yacht features a very comfortable master suite with a private bathroom and walk-in wardrobe, as well as two smaller cabins, each with its own bathroom. The yacht comfortably accommodates up to six guests, although the smallest cabin is best suited for children. Two of the bathrooms are equipped with showers, and all bathrooms include a toilet.
